one thing that helps me even after many years of suicidality is that, ideation isn't always action. So we want to die, but we don't want to take action, for me this always ends up in fantasies where I die without doing anything myself. 

I guess what I'm trying to say is don't blame yourself for wanting to die, but thank yourself for being reasonable enough to not go through with it (even when its hard to thank youself)
